notes.title: Major update and Discount ending soon
notes.notes:
We have just publish a major update, following are the detail.

- Stability improvements
- Audio output compatibility 
- Game balance adjustment
- Localization improvement
- Certain texture quality adjustment

This update should resolve most issues reported by players. Including losing in-game audio, random crash at the launch. 

The build number is: 1372134

If you have encounter any problem or suggests, please let us a message on the forum. 

In-addition, the Launch discount is ending soon. You can save 20% for the Edge of Twilight base program, and Ultimate Collector's Edition for 30% discount.

Thank you for supporting. And we are doing our best to provide better game experiences.
